drawer.title: Side Menu
drawer.description: This is your main menu. From here you can access every section of the app. Let's walk through them one by one.

welcome.title: Welcome to MisterData!
welcome.description: Your all-in-one assistant to manage your team like a professional. Let's walk through every tool together.
welcome.b1: Manage tournaments, players and training sessions
welcome.b2: Create exercises with videos from the tactical board
welcome.b4: Analyse rivals and keep detailed match sheets
welcome.tip: You can swipe between steps or use the navigation buttons.

home.title: Home
home.description: Your main dashboard with a general overview of the team, the active season and quick access to every section.
home.tip: This is your starting point every time you open the app.

season.title: Seasons
season.description: Create and manage your team's seasons. Each season groups tournaments, training sessions and all team activity.
season.tip: Always start by creating a season before adding tournaments or planning training.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.description: Create and organise every competition your team participates in throughout the season.
tournaments.tip: Well-organised tournaments let you filter statistics and matches by competition.

players.title: Players
players.description: Register every player in your squad with complete information for full team control.
players.tip: The more data you add, the more accurate your statistics and injury tracking will be.

tacticalBoard.title: Tactical Board
tacticalBoard.description: Design plays, movements and tactical patterns on the pitch with professional drawing tools.
tacticalBoard.tip: Videos created on the board appear automatically in My Videos.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: Build your exercise library in themed folders and enrich them with tactical board videos.
exercises.tip: A well-organised exercise library makes training planning much faster.

strategies.title: Strategies & Tactics
strategies.description: Design and organise your team's tactical strategies: set pieces, defensive schemes, transitions and more.
strategies.tip: Organise strategies in folders for quick access.

videos.title: My Videos
videos.description: Access all videos generated from the tactical board. Organise them and link them to exercises.
videos.tip: Videos are generated automatically when you record from the tactical board.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.description: Define your team's playing model: tactical, technical and physical principles for each period of the season.
methodology.tip: A clear methodology guides the planning of all your training sessions.

goalkeeperMethodology.title: Goalkeeper Methodology
goalkeeperMethodology.description: Define the specific training methodology for your goalkeepers, with differentiated goals and content.
goalkeeperMethodology.tip: Complement the team's general methodology with goalkeeper-specific work.

training.title: Training Sessions
training.description: Plan and record every training session with full details for complete control.
training.tip: Link exercises from your library to reuse them easily in every session.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.description: Monitor your players' physical and mental state before and after each training session.
wellness.tip: Regular wellness monitoring prevents injuries and improves performance.

rivals.title: Rivals
rivals.description: Create and manage the opposing teams your team will face throughout the season.
rivals.tip: Register each rival with their badge and basic details to keep your competition organised.

matchSheets.title: Match Sheets
matchSheets.description: Record every match with lineup, events and results for a complete history.
matchSheets.tip: Match sheets automatically feed your team's statistics.

injuries.title: Injury Control
injuries.description: Keep a thorough record of every injury to manage your players' recovery effectively.
injuries.tip: Injury history helps detect patterns and prevent recurrences.

rivalAnalysis.title: Rival Analysis
rivalAnalysis.description: Study in depth how your rivals play: tactical system, strengths, weaknesses and playing patterns to prepare for each match.
rivalAnalysis.tip: Review the analysis before each fixture to fine-tune your tactical approach.

anthropometry.title: Anthropometry
anthropometry.description: Record and monitor skinfolds, weight and body measurements for each player to track body composition over time.
anthropometry.tip: Regular measurements help detect changes in players' body composition.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: View individual and collective team performance with data from matches, training sessions and wellness.
statistics.tip: Combine statistics from different sources for a complete performance overview.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Manage personalised nutritional tracking for each player to optimise performance and recovery.
nutrition.tip: Proper nutritional planning complements training and improves recovery.

injuryPrevention.title: Injury Prevention
injuryPrevention.description: Implement prevention protocols with specific exercises and tracking to reduce injury risk across your squad.
injuryPrevention.tip: Active prevention significantly reduces injury rates throughout the season.

ready.title: All set to start!
ready.description: You now know every tool in MisterData. Start by creating a season and registering your players. Your team is in great hands!
